reason: Continue toward unchanged token/accuracy/harm goals using retraining and explicit structural guard.
split_scope: New wording/layout families and sources, eight already observed high-level structures. Not unseen-structure OOD.
neural_training: Train three predeclared MLP seeds on old development only; select epochs by group-disjoint internal validation then refit fixed epochs on all old development.
structural_guard: Explicit pre-answer rule: reject a candidate when a valid original JSON document becomes invalid JSON. Disclosed hybrid, not pure-neural attribution.
calibration_selection: Select operating threshold/primary among predeclared hybrid candidate families using new calibration only. Test is never used for selection.
calibration_tier_rule: Examine harm tolerances from strictest upward; choose maximum-token-saving feasible candidate in the first tier admitting saving>=.20 and accuracy_delta>=-.0125. If no tier feasible, do not freeze/test; continue development.
final_test_rule: Freeze neural weights, selected hybrid policy and thresholds before test labeling. All predefined strategies are reported; no choice on test.
limitations: JSON syntax guard does not guarantee semantic correctness.
Observed test targets are empirical, not a deployment risk guarantee.
